- **Target_Spot** — ruled out (small dark pinpoint spots)
- **TYLCV** — ruled out (dramatic curling/stunting)
- **Mosaic viruses** — ruled out (mottled dark/light green pattern, not yellow patches)

The symptom description for Leaf_Mold — "pale greenish-yellow spots, usually less than 1/4 inch with no definite margins, on the upper sides of leaves" — matches precisely.
